headline: Fleet-wide factory health in one command
before_state: Factory health understanding required stitching together raw metrics and merge output across separate surfaces.
after_state: A single release brief now carries deterministic significance context and comprehension framing for shipped changes.
summary: Release reporting now clusters shipped goals, merge throughput, and wave timing into a single understanding brief instead of a noisy merge-by-merge stream.
conceptual_shift: Release reporting moved from per-merge narration to a significance-gated comprehension brief.
why_it_matters: The team gets fewer interruptions and a cleaner mental model of what changed in the factory.
proof_points: Goal #1517 delivered release report context assembly with deterministic worthiness scoring.
structural_changes: release-worthiness now emits deterministic significance fields consumed by release narration.
behavioral_shifts: Narration now expects comprehension framing whenever worthiness marks the window as significant.
implicit_decisions: The significance threshold is currently heuristic and should be monitored for calibration drift.
watch_items: If the threshold is too strict, large goals may still need explicit escalation.
